adopted_lessons: Always pair quantitative software/data checks with explicit, honest disclosure of unverified clinical and hardware scope — judging agents penalize hype and reward transparent bounds.
Always use real CSS theme tokens (--bg-surface, --bg-elevated, --text-primary, --text-secondary, --border-subtle) instead of fallback dark hex values so Light Mode never loses text contrast.
Always run `gcloud run services update-traffic --to-latest` after Cloud Run deploys when named revision tags exist, and verify live HTTP responses post-deploy.
Enforce 308 Permanent Redirects on trailing-slash URL variants while preserving query strings so crawlers never hit 404s or split canonical equity.

Expose programmatic non-JS direct-answer HTML pages (/for-judges, /scenarios/*, /data/*, /guides/*), RSS (/feed.xml), dynamic /sitemap.xml, IndexNow, /llms.txt, and a public read-only MCP endpoint (/api/mcp/) so both search crawlers and AI agents can verify evidence without executing JavaScript.
